name: jazz_acoustic
description: Jazz / acoustic / singer-songwriter / folk. Highly dynamic, natural top end, gentle low end. Light or no limiting — LRA stays high to preserve performance dynamics.
sources: iZotope Tonal Balance Control 3 reference curve naming (Jazz / Vocal Jazz / Folk)
Streaming mastering guides 2025: jazz/acoustic target -16 to -20 LUFS typical
Calibrated: modern_rock baseline + jazz spectral shifts (sub -4, low -2, mid +1.5)
calibration_note: Tonal balance targets are wideband band-RMS at integrated_target LUFS. Jazz / acoustic has reduced sub and emphasised instrument body in the mids.
